verbatim_snippet: "At Domestika you will find promotions in course bundles so that you can enjoy an additional discount by buying more than one course at a time on specific software, technique or creative area. In the list of course bundles that you check here, you will find: Set bundles: the courses are already selected. Customizable bundles: you can select the number of courses applicable to the bundle from a selection."
what: Two bundle types: set (pre-selected courses) and customizable. Built-in discount; **no additional discount codes allowed on bundles**.
